title: Sahaja Yoga
description: Sahaja Yoga is a unique method of meditation based on the experience of Self-realisation through Kundalini Awakening. It establishes a deep state of inner silence and joy, where one experiences the deepest self, free from unhelpful thoughts, anxieties and worries. It is free and everyone is welcome to join.

title: Zumba
description: Get moving, have fun, and keep fit with our Free Zumba Classes! Join us for an energising workout that combines lively music with easy-to-follow dance moves. No experience needed, just bring your enthusiasm and a smile!

title: English Session
description: The Free English Sessions for Senior Citizens aim to support elderly members of our community who face difficulties with the English language. These sessions provide a comfortable and understanding environment where participants can learn useful communication skills, improve confidence, and engage more easily in daily life. The focus is on practical English for real situations, with patient guidance and a friendly atmosphere.

title: Wonderful Wednesday
description: This Special Session to Tackle Loneliness aims to bring people together and strengthen community connections. The event offers a safe and welcoming space where participants can socialise, share experiences, and enjoy a freshly prepared lunch together. By encouraging conversation and friendship, the session helps reduce feelings of isolation and promotes wellbeing among attendees.

title: Art Therapy
description: Join our fun and creative Art Programme for children! This free programme encourages young artists to express themselves through drawing, painting, and craft activities. It’s a great way for children to explore their imagination, build confidence, and make new friends in a supportive environment. All materials are provided — just bring your creativity!
